messages:
Samira - CS: Zenith asked for compact enablement this week: 3x45m office hours (APAC/EU/NA) + 60m migration workshop. Can we lock slots?

Diego - Enablement: I can do Wed/Thu PST. Proposal (UTC): APAC 04:00, EU 13:00, NA 20:00. Workshop Thu 16:00 (60m). 45m office hours ok.

Priya - Scheduling: Are these private to Zenith? Need facilitator pairing and RSVP rules.

Samira - CS: Zenith-only. Renewal risk flagged in QBR, Ethan owns follow-up.

Ethan - Success: I'll prepare account-health + want a 15m post-workshop risk sync with stakeholders.

Diego - Enablement: Add 15m post-workshop. Recommend pre-read + 3-question feedback to capture blockers/confidence.

Priya - Scheduling: Tentative availability grid (UTC): APAC Mon/Thu 04:00; EU Tue/Wed 13:00; NA Wed/Thu 20:00; Workshop Thu 16:00. I'll tentatively block and send invites with 48h RSVP.

cal-bot: calendar invites created (tentative) and shared with samira@redwood, diego@redwood, ethan@redwood, priya@redwood, zenith-pm@zenith.

Diego - Enablement: Facilitator plan: APAC: Diego + Priya(notes); EU: Samira + Diego; NA: Ethan + Diego; Workshop: Diego + Eng SME (TBD).

Samira - CS: Please add a short runbook and one-page pre-read (infra checklist + API key rotation sample) to invites.

Diego - Enablement: Runbook snippet added to invites: Objective: demo Dedicated->Private switch and SSO + key rotation checks. Prereqs: service account w/ RBAC, model pinned, staging VPC access. Deliverable: migration ticket + timeline.

Ethan - Success: I'll capture feedback and escalate any P0/P1 blockers to customer-success-ops.

Priya - Scheduling: Recording + transcript enabled; auto-summary on. Links will be attached in follow-up.

Diego - Enablement: Draft feedback form (3 Qs): 1) Runbook clarity (1-5) 2) Any blockers in next 30d? (free text) 3) Confidence to migrate <60d (1-5).

Samira - CS: Final owners: confirm times (Samira), invites (Priya), runbooks (Diego), acct slides & risk call (Ethan), Eng SME booking (Samira). Once Zenith confirms, convert tentative invites to confirmed and we'll post a short retro in #customer-success. Closing loop.
